method.masking: Reuse the pinned BBC room and ES2012b AMI annotated speech recording from ODSS. Reserve the eight ODSS assessment excerpts before selecting nonoverlapping new excerpts. Use the same new masker, location and common gain for all three origins per case. Alternate left and right. Measure room mean level at 0 and -5 dB. Use the identical background-only waveform and repeat room-only native scores.
method.policy: Freeze each operating point from ODSS development before new model inference. The selective route preserves mono flags and adds a flag only if native mono meets the ODSS development one-genuine-reader point and both cleaned views exceed their respective zero-genuine-reader points. The ODSS assessment remains retrospective. Report each generator and genuine/background counts and original utterance-reader groups independently.
method.source: Use complete archived WAV members and exact publisher utterance identifiers with unique normalized transcripts. Select three prompts per source reader by salted SHA-256 from utterances of 6 to 14 seconds in each version with a maximum duration ratio of 1.25. Use each origin's first six seconds, then score the fixed middle three seconds. The full prompt matches by construction. This cropped middle interval is not phoneme-aligned across origins.
